description: Chop down trees using axe from your inventory, with uprooting stumps using shovel from your inventory. You can uproot stumps or cut down bushes at the same time, also ignoring growing trees. Auto-refilling waterskins from nearby container is also possible if you have water in a barrel (or cistern) in an area that has 'water' spec. You can also eat food from inventory when hunger is low enough.

description: Bot able to chip boulders in area, or digging rocks from mountain tiles. Select desired instrument for chipping, activate refilling from nearby water area (with 'water' spec) or eating food from your inventory. For digging mountain you need to have pickaxe in your belt.

description: The bot collects leaves from trees. Specify an area with trees to collect leaves from. Then specify the area where to place the leaf piles.

description: Picks leaves from every tree and bush in the nearest 'Trees' area that still has leaves, and carries them to the PUT areas set up for each leaf, as many trips as it takes. Needs no input, so it also works as a scenario step. Trees whose leaf has no PUT area are skipped.
title: Leaf Picker (Zones)

description: Looks around for anything the LP helper still marks undiscovered (leaves, nuts and fruit, boughs, bark, boards, blocks, stones). Walks to the nearest reachable one, collects a single item, and repeats until nothing in view has anything left to find. Equips a saw, axe or pickaxe from the belt when needed. Each gathered item is dropped on the ground.
title: LP Gatherer

description: For a normal fishing rod: Select the area to be fished (the middle is selected). Optionally, select if there is a special extra container (fishing lines and hooks).Select the area with bait. And select the area where you want to put the fish. The bot will repair the rod, refill the bait and place the fish in piles. For casting-rod you can specify which of the fish the bot should catch and it will select only those fish when fishing

description: Makes cheese continuously from the orders in Nurgling Settings > Bots > Cheese conveyor. A continuous order starts a few trays every run (N trays every H hours), so some cheese finishes every run instead of all at once. It uses the same setup as the Cheese Production Bot: TAKE areas for each curd type, a PUT/TAKE area for empty trays, a PUT area for sliced cheese, and cheese rack areas (outside, inside, mine, cellar) with buffer containers that hold at least as many trays as the racks. Use one cheese bot per set of racks, and the Calculators tool to size them. Global PF is supported.

description: Bot is engaged in improving the quality of ducks and cutting their carcasses. Ducks live in ordinary Chicken Coops, so duck zones are told apart from chicken zones by specialisation only: mark the breeding coops 'Duck' and the hatching coops 'Duckling Incubator'. The bot promotes the best drakes and duck hens into the breeding coops, moves ducklings to the incubators, culls the excess, and collects every egg of worse quality than the worst duck hen in the best coop. You also need a zone with water and one with swill, each with a barrel, and optionally a cistern. All other products are distributed by the zone system (section 'Put').
